principles.adult_content_tone: The game may include mature adult relationship themes.
principles.adult_only_rule: Romantic and sexual relationship mechanics apply only to adult-equivalent characters.
principles.pairing_rule: romantic/sexual pairing requires one adult male and one adult female character under the project's authored sex-category model
principles.no_fallback_widening: Procedural systems may not widen or reinterpret romantic/sexual compatibility when no eligible partner exists.
principles.consent: Consent remains contextual, explicit in state/event terms, and may be refused or withdrawn.
principles.autonomy: No friendship, favor, rank, persistence, attraction or existing relationship implies consent.

step_boundaries.step_9: non-romantic social life only; romantic/sexual event generation prohibited
step_boundaries.step_10: romance and dating mechanics must consume this canon
step_boundaries.later_steps: NPC-to-NPC relationship evolution and off-screen simulation must preserve this canon

nonromantic_rule: Friendship, familiarity, trust, rivalry, mentorship, professional respect and ordinary social participation are not restricted by romantic compatibility.
ai_boundary: AI may express compatible authored relationship state but cannot broaden romantic/sexual eligibility.
AI may not invent consent, attraction or sexual/romantic history.
AI may not reinterpret this canon from prose context.
